COASTER-POV-DOWN-THE-DROP — camera locked at the crest-rail as the coaster-car tips over the first plunge, screaming minifigs gripping the bar, the entire brick midway sprawling dizzyingly below.

FERRIS-WHEEL-LOOKING-UP — camera planted at the wheel-base craneing straight up the radial spoke-beams, gondola-ring rotating against a pale-blue brick sky, bulb-string rim blazing in severe upward scale.

MIDWAY-DOWN-THE-GAME-ROW — camera low at shin-height down the striped-stall lane, prize-walls and string-lights receding to a vanishing-point arch, minifig crowds pressing both sides in bustling brick depth.

AERIAL-PARK-OVERVIEW — camera high and pulled back over the complete brick fairground, coaster-loop plus ferris-wheel plus carousel plus midway all laid out as a living master-shot convention display.

UNDER-THE-COASTER-STRUCTURE — camera beneath the Technic-beam lattice looking upward as a coaster-car thunders across the track overhead, the cross-braced framework creating dramatic structural tunnel depth.

CAROUSEL-FROM-INSIDE — camera positioned within the carousel ring looking outward past spinning brick horse-mounts and barber-pole columns, canopy-lights blazing overhead, the park rotating beautifully beyond the gilded frame.

PARADE-ROUTE-LOW — camera at curb-brick level as a decorated parade-float rolls past, costumed minifigs tossing trans-element streamers overhead, crowd-arms reaching into frame from both packed sides.

DUSK-SKYLINE-OF-RIDES — camera set back at blue-hour capturing silhouetted coaster-loop, ferris-wheel, and drop-tower against a dark-blue brick sky, every structure outlined in glowing trans-element lights.
WATER-SLIDE-BASE-UP — camera at the splash-pool edge looking up the twisting trans-blue flume-tower, a log-car bursting down the final chute into a foaming white round-plate splash below.

QUEUE-LINE-EYE-LEVEL — camera at minifig eye-height winding through the switchback rope-queue, packed waiting minifigs leading the gaze straight toward the ride-entrance trans-element marquee, thick with anticipation.

COASTER-FIRST-DROP-SIDE-PROFILE — camera level with the track midway down the drop, the full coaster-car silhouetted mid-plunge against the open sky, the steel-coloured support lattice framing both sides.
FERRIS-WHEEL-GONDOLA-OUTWARD — camera inside a suspended gondola looking out past the brick safety-bar to the entire brick park below, the spoke-ring curving away left and right magnificently.

MIDWAY-PRIZE-WALL-CLOSE — camera tight against a game-stall prize-wall of stacked plush-brick animals, the booth-attendant minifig leaning forward, the bustling game-lane receding alive behind the vivid wall.
COASTER-LIFT-HILL-ASCENT — camera behind the coaster-car as it climbs the chain-driven lift-hill, the track rising to a vanishing point above while the brick park shrinks dramatically below.

CAROUSEL-HORSE-PROFILE — camera at ride-height beside a single ornate brick horse-mount mid-rotation, barber-pole columns blurring behind, the canopy-fringe catching the warm overhead carousel lighting beautifully.
DROP-TOWER-PEAK-LOOKING-DOWN — camera at the very top of the drop-tower gondola ring peering straight down the tower column to the tiny brick plaza and minifig crowd far below.
WATER-SLIDE-MID-FLUME — camera tucked inside a trans-blue flume curve looking forward as the log-car rounds the bend, white-water detail spraying outward, the splash-pool glinting at the base.

PARADE-FLOAT-ABOARD — camera mounted level with the float-deck looking forward along the parade-route, cheering minifig crowds lining both sides, trans-element confetti arcing through the brick festival air.
COASTER-BANKING-TURN-TRACKSIDE — camera positioned outside a banked curve at rail-height, the coaster-car leaning hard through the bend, the drop-tower and midway visible behind.
DROP-TOWER-BASE-LOOKING-UP — camera at the foot of the drop-tower column craning upward along the brick-plate shaft as a screaming minifig car-pod climbs toward the top.
ROLLER-COASTER-LOOP-INTERIOR — camera placed inside the vertical loop looking out through the circular track-frame, a coaster-car entering the top of the loop against open sky.
CAROUSEL-CANOPY-DOWN — camera above the carousel canopy shooting straight down through spinning barber-pole columns to the ring of brick horse-mounts and riders below.
COASTER-FIRST-HILL-CLIMB-REAR — camera behind the coaster-car on the lift-hill chain, looking back down over the track at the station-building and midway-crowds below.
WATER-SLIDE-MID-FLUME-CURVE — camera embedded in a trans-blue flume bend, the log-car cornering toward the camera, the splash-pool and brick park visible at the bottom.
NIGHT-MIDWAY-OVERHEAD-STRING-LIGHTS — camera looking straight up at intersecting string-light cables above the midway lane, the game-stall rooftops receding to either side below.
COASTER-STATION-PLATFORM-LEVEL — camera on the loading-platform at minifig height, an arriving coaster-car filling the foreground, the lift-hill climbing away toward the sky behind.
FERRIS-WHEEL-SPOKE-ALONGSIDE — camera positioned at mid-height alongside a single radial spoke, the full gondola-ring curving away above, the brick park ground far below.
BUMPER-CAR-RINK-LOW — camera at floor-grid level inside the bumper-car arena, minifig drivers careening past, the overhead power-rail and perimeter barriers closing in from all sides.
COASTER-AIRTIME-HILL-PROFILE — camera side-on at track-height as the coaster-car launches over a low ejector-hill, minifig hands raised, the ride-skyline of the full park behind.
QUEUE-LINE-ENTRANCE-ARCH-THROUGH — camera beyond the entrance-arch looking back out through its trans-element sign at the waiting queue-crowd stretching far down the switchback lane.
COASTER-LAUNCH-TUNNEL-EXIT — camera at the tunnel-mouth as the coaster-car explodes from a dark brick portal into open daylight, the full park panorama snapping into view behind the car.

CAROUSEL-TOP-DOWN — camera directly above the carousel canopy looking straight down through the spinning canopy-lights to horse-mounts and minifig riders circling below, the radial symmetry mesmerising.
WATER-SLIDE-MID-FLUME-TURN — camera tucked inside a banked mid-tower curve as a log-car whips through the bend, trans-blue flume walls close on both sides, the ride momentum palpable.
PARADE-ROUTE-FLOAT-ABOARD — camera atop a brick parade-float looking back along the parade-route, the crowd lining both curb-bricks stretching into the distance behind streamers and confetti-tiles.
COASTER-LIFT-HILL-PROFILE — camera side-on at ground level shooting the full chain-lift incline, a coaster-car climbing the slope against open sky, the scale-tension of the impending drop building.
QUEUE-LINE-ENTRANCE-ARCH — camera stepping back to frame the full ride-entrance arch overhead, trans-element lettering blazing, the queue switchback of minifig crowds funnelling through below.
FERRIS-WHEEL-SPOKE-PORTRAIT — camera pressed close to one radial spoke shooting up its full length to the gondola it supports, the rim-bulbs curving away on both sides in the background.
MIDWAY-NIGHT-REFLECTIONS — camera low on wet-plate midway bricks, game-stall string-lights and prize-wall colours reflected in the glossy surface, minifig feet cutting through the shimmering lane.
AERIAL-COASTER-SPINE-FOLLOW — camera above and behind the coaster-train tracking its full spine as it threads the layout, the park grid of paths and stalls visible to each side below.
UNDER-CAROUSEL-PLATFORM — camera beneath the carousel platform looking up through the mechanical-ring and pole-anchors to the spinning canopy above, the ride geometry exposed and dazzling.

DUSK-COASTER-SILHOUETTE — camera at park-edge framing the coaster-spine as a pure silhouette against trans-orange dusk bricks, a single car perched at the drop-crest, lights threading the track below.

WATER-SLIDE-QUEUE-TOWER-STAIRS — camera at minifig height on the open-stair climb, each landing revealing more of the park below through the flume-tower's open Technic frame, anticipation rising with every step.

COASTER-LOOP-TRACKSIDE — camera positioned low beside the loop invert as a minifig car crests the full circle upside-down, the midway stall-rooftops and ferris-wheel visible framed within the circular track opening.

CAROUSEL-HORSE-CLOSE-TIGHT — camera pressed close to a single ornate brick horse-mount mid-rotation, blurred barber-pole columns flanking it, the carousel canopy-lights streaking overhead in implied centrifugal spin.
